headlines.text: It was 2021 when Tony Nese stepped through the curtain for the first time against Sammy Guevara, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.23 ? a solid showing. Nese's official AEW in-ring debut, targeting the champion's taped-up ribs from a previous street fight ? a competitive title challenge that saw Nese nearly steal the win with a 450 splash before Guevara survived with the GTH.
It was 2025 when Kyle Fletcher vs. Kevin Knight met in a Continental Classic League Match on Dynamite, rated 8.10 ? a real highlight of the night.
Flash back to 2025, when Bayne & Shafir left that name behind for good, stepping out as The MegaProblems after 3 matches under the old identity, on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2025, when Claudio Castagnoli vs. Jon Moxley met in a Continental Classic League Match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 7.92 ? a good, competitive contest.
On a Friday in 2021, back when it marked the first-ever meeting between FTR and PAC & Penta, closing out the card as the main event on Rampage, rated 7.71 ? a strong outing.
On a Wednesday in 2025, back when PAC reached proof of just how much mileage they've put in: their 100th match in AEW, facing Kazuchika Okada vs. PAC, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 6.81.
